headline: Digtoise mining
title: Digtoise | Mining Boost Up To 2000 Percent | Palworld Guide
video_script: Digtoise is one of the strongest miners in Palworld one point zero. It has Mining level four. Its partner skill, Drill Crusher, makes it spin and follow you, and mining efficiency jumps by eight hundred to two thousand percent. Put it in your party while you farm ore and watch the rocks melt. Do you farm ore with Digtoise yet? Comment below!
description: Digtoise gives a huge ore mining boost in Palworld 1.0 through its Drill Crusher partner skill.
